name: druid
lore:
The Druid is no mere resident of the wilds; they are the living conscience of the land. To encounter one is to meet the forest’s own gaze—ancient, patient, and profoundly indifferent to the fleeting squabbles of kings. They dwell where the veil between the material and the primal thins, whispering in the forgotten tongue of root and stone.

Their behavior mirrors the seasons: tranquil as a summer pond, yet sudden and devastating as a mountain gale when the balance is threatened. They do not merely study nature; they embody its fluidity. A Druid may stand before you as a moss-strewn hermit one moment, only for their bones to lengthen and fur to sprout, transforming into a Great Grey Wolf before your very eyes. Respect the silence of the deep groves, traveler, for in those shadows, the trees have ears, and the earth itself has teeth.
